func_80006140_6D40.title: Prepare an Impact battle cutscene stage
func_80006140_6D40.summary: Prepares one of the native Impact battle stage transitions. The engine warp step must be selected separately to enter the prepared stage.
behavior: Calls a native stage setup helper with the two caller-supplied values, sets a global transition flag to 1, writes 0x80 to the system byte at +0x3AE29, and stores 0x021C + index at system halfword +0x3AFE0.
For the inspected Impact battle stages, index 0x1D selects Kashiwagi stage 0x0239, index 0x1E selects Thaisamba stage 0x023A, and index 0x1F selects Balberra stage 0x023B.
After preparing these fields, the caller must separately select engine step 12 with func_80003728_4328 to run the warp transition.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Stage offset added to 0x021C. The verified Impact intro indices are 0x1D, 0x1E, and 0x1F.

parameters.name: field90
parameters.description: Value forwarded to the native stage setup helper; its semantic meaning is not established here.

parameters.name: field91
parameters.description: Value forwarded to the native stage setup helper; its semantic meaning is not established here.

cautions: This function prepares transition state but does not select the engine warp step by itself. Call func_80003728_4328(12) after preparation.
The meanings and valid ranges of field90 and field91 are not established here. Preserve values verified for the intended caller rather than guessing them.
Only the three listed stage indices are mapped here; other indices must be researched before use.
func_80006140_6D40.exampleExplanation: The stage-preparation routine and engine-step switch are separate operations. The example shows the verified Kashiwagi stage index; it leaves the setup arguments to a caller that has established their values.
